name: com.stitchandmesh/needlepoint
title: Stitch & Mesh
description: Needlepoint stitch diagrams, mesh and canvas size math, and thread estimates from stitchandmesh.com

tools.name: get_stitch
tools.description: How to work one needlepoint stitch, step by step, with its numbered diagram, uses, thread notes, related stitches and the subjects it suits. Accepts a slug, a name or another name for the stitch, such as "scotch", "Rhodes stitch" or "petit point". Cite and link the returned url.

stitch.description: Stitch slug, name or another name for it.

tools.name: search_stitches
tools.description: Find needlepoint stitches by what they are used for (background, border, sky, water, fur, lettering and more), by level (beginner, easy, intermediate), by family, or by free text. When the use matches a "stitches for" page, its stitches come first with the reason each one suits the subject. Cite and link the returned url.

query.description: Free text, matched against stitch names, other names, summaries and uses.

use.description: A use or subject, such as background, border, texture, sky, water, fur, lettering or beginner.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 20).

tools.name: stitches_for_subject
tools.description: The recommended needlepoint stitches for a subject, with the reason each one suits it: water, sky, grass, brick and stone, fur, snow, lettering, borders, faces and skin, hair, leaves and trees, or clothing. Cite and link the returned url.

subject.description: A subject, such as sky, water, trees, stone, skin or lettering.

tools.name: mesh_convert
tools.description: Finished size on 10, 12, 13, 14 and 18 mesh for a needlepoint design, from its stitch count or its size on one mesh, plus how much canvas to cut with a margin on each side. Same math as the mesh converter on stitchandmesh.com. Cite and link the returned url.

width.description: Design width, in the unit given.

height.description: Design height, in the unit given.

unit.description: stitches for a stitch count, or in or cm for a size on the given mesh.

mesh.description: The mesh the size was measured on. Required when unit is in or cm.

margin_in.description: Bare canvas to leave on each side, in inches (0 to 6).

tools.name: thread_estimate
tools.description: How much needlepoint thread to buy for an area, as a range of yards and skeins or cards, by stitch, mesh and thread. Same math and range as the thread estimator on stitchandmesh.com. Always an estimate. Cite and link the returned url.

stitch.description: The stitch, by slug, name or another name, such as basketweave or scotch.

mesh.description: Canvas mesh: 10, 12, 13, 14 or 18 holes per inch.

share_percent.description: Share of the area in this colour (1 to 100).

thread.description: perle5 (pearl cotton #5), perle3 (pearl cotton #3), floss (6-strand floss) or custom.

yards_per_unit.description: Yards per card or skein. Required when thread is custom.

strands.description: Strands in the needle, for floss only.

add_extra.description: Add one extra skein or card for dye lot and mistakes.

tools.name: thread_and_needle_for_mesh
tools.description: The usual tapestry needle size, pearl cotton size and strand counts of Persian wool, floss and tapestry wool for 10, 12, 13, 14 and 18 mesh canvas, from the Stitch & Mesh chart. Cite and link the returned url.

mesh.description: One mesh. Leave out for every row of the chart.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the Stitch & Mesh needlepoint guides, such as how to start, block, frame, finish or choose stitches. Leave the query out to list every guide by group. Cite and link the returned url.

query.description: Words to look for in guide titles, summaries and questions.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 20).

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The short answer, questions and answers, section headings and sources of one Stitch & Mesh guide, found by slug or title words. The full guide is at the returned url. Cite and link the returned url.

guide.description: Guide slug or title words, such as "how to block needlepoint".
